summary: ERICSSON LM TELEPHONE CO filed a Form 6-K with the SEC reporting its share buyback program. The registrant repurchased 2,850,000 Class B shares between August 31 and September 4, 2026, at an average weighted price of SEK 96.8158 per share, totaling SEK 275,924,950. The repurchases fall under a previously announced program of up to SEK 15,000,000,000, running from April 23, 2026, through March 31, 2027. The Board intends to propose cancellation of repurchased shares (except those for incentive programs). The buybacks were executed through Goldman Sachs Bank Europe SE on Nasdaq Stockholm. Following repurchases, 105,668,676 treasury shares are held. This is a routine periodic update, not an event announcement.
